requirement_text.REQ-005:
GitHub issue #4 ("Add KZ translation") asks for a Kazakh version of the site, structurally identical to issue #3 resolved by REQ-003+REQ-004 -- this requirement mirrors REQ-003's split exactly, for Kazakh.

Locale code decision: ISO 639-1 code "kk" (distinct from "KZ", the ISO 3166-1 country code used only in region-tagged variants like OpenGraph's kk_KZ).

Verified current state: src/i18n/routing.ts defines locales: ["ru", "uz", "en"], defaultLocale: "ru". No "kk" locale exists anywhere. messages/ru.json, uz.json, en.json each hold exactly 177 leaf keys with matching key sets. src/i18n/request.ts, src/components/landing/LocaleSwitcher.tsx, and src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx are all confirmed locale-count-agnostic by construction (dynamic import + hasLocale/defaultLocale fallback; generic map over routing.locales; dynamic <html lang> + ogLocale read from the message catalog) -- none need code changes.

defaultLocale decision: stays "ru". No source states a reason to change it.

Scope of work:
- Add "kk" to the locales array in src/i18n/routing.ts, after "en" (locales: ["ru", "uz", "en", "kk"]), keeping defaultLocale: "ru" unchanged.
- Create messages/kk.json containing every key currently present in messages/ru.json (same 177-key structure/nesting), every value set to the Russian source string duplicated verbatim as a placeholder, including Metadata.ogLocale seeded as the placeholder "ru_RU" -- translation content (including the real kk_KZ ogLocale value) is out of scope for this requirement, REQ-006 (depends_on this requirement) handles that.
- No change expected to request.ts/LocaleSwitcher.tsx/layout.tsx per the verified-state note; if implementation finds otherwise, state what was found and why.

task.description: Design REQ-005: adding a fourth locale ('kk') to this project's next-intl i18n mechanism -- structurally identical to REQ-003 (which added 'en' as the third locale). Read docs/agents/design/REQ-003.md as your direct template/precedent since the shape of this change is the same. Write docs/agents/design/REQ-005.md per WF-02 Step 1's procedure, covering: which files change (src/i18n/routing.ts, messages/kk.json -- new file), explicit confirmation of which files do NOT change and why (verify by reading them yourself, don't just copy REQ-003's design doc's claims without re-checking), the exact shape of messages/kk.json (matches messages/ru.json's structure exactly, Metadata.ogLocale placeholder value), and any design-token/responsive/theme considerations (state explicitly if none apply). If your own reading confirms this needs no new component structure, say so plainly.
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-005 acceptance criterion maps to a concrete design element or an explicit statement of 'no change needed, verified by reading <file>'

The 'no code change needed' claims for request.ts/LocaleSwitcher.tsx/layout.tsx are independently re-verified by reading the current files yourself (not just copied from REQ-003's design doc, since the files may have changed since)

State the Metadata.ogLocale placeholder value decision (should be 'ru_RU' per the requirement text's explicit statement, unlike REQ-003 which had an open question about this -- confirm this is settled, not still open)

result.summary: Wrote docs/agents/design/REQ-005.md mirroring REQ-003's design doc structure for the fourth locale ('kk'). Verified directly against today's source (not copied from REQ-003's doc): routing.ts currently has locales ['ru','uz','en'] (REQ-003's 'en' already landed) with no 'kk' present; request.ts, LocaleSwitcher.tsx, and layout.tsx are all confirmed generic over routing.locales by direct reading today, quoted in the doc, so none need code changes. messages/ru.json verified programmatically to hold exactly 177 leaf keys under 13 namespaces, with uz.json and en.json confirmed to have identical key sets. messages/kk.json does not yet exist. The design specifies: (1) routing.ts locales array gets 'kk' appended after 'en', defaultLocale stays 'ru'; (2) new messages/kk.json with the same 177-key/13-namespace shape as ru.json, every value the Russian source string duplicated verbatim as placeholder, including Metadata.ogLocale seeded as the literal placeholder 'ru_RU' per the requirement text's explicit instruction (not an inferred locale-format value the way REQ-003 had to infer en_US for en.json). No design-token/responsive/theme changes apply (no visual/layout/interactive code touched; .lang flex-row CSS already accommodates a variable number of children). Zero open questions -- every value needed (locale code 'kk', defaultLocale unchanged, ogLocale placeholder value) is stated explicitly in the requirement text, unlike REQ-003 which had to flag its ogLocale value as an open question.
